My plot is very small, only a little more than a quarter acre, and I keep my maize intercropped with beans like I did last season. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but one full bag of urea is too much for this little piece and costs more cash than I can spare — I will buy just a small share of a bag with my sister and put a little at planting. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I am keeping the seed I saved from last harvest, and I will weed myself with my children since the plot is close to the house. No irrigation here, we wait for the masika rains.
